title: Average Price Trends
scenario: Find the average price for each product, but only for years where the product's total sales quantity exceeded 20 units. Return 'product_id', 'year', and 'avg_price'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Group by product_id and year, filter by SUM(quantity) > 20.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, year, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM sales GROUP BY product_id, year HAVING SUM(quantity) > 20;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 25, 5000), (2, 100, 2008, 5, 5000);
